sloka: तत् धनुः तौ च तूणि च शरम् खड्गम् च मानद ।जयाय प्रतिगृह्णीष्व वज्रम् वज्रधरो यथा ॥३-१२-३६॥
transliteration: tat dhanuḥ tau ca tūṇi ca śaram khaḍgam ca mānada ।jayāya pratigṛhṇīṣva vajram vajradharo yathā ॥3-12-36॥

translations.english: O bestower of honour, receive this bow, the two quivers, the sword and the arrow for your victory just like Indra accepts the thunderbolt.
